اقتطفتم (form VIII)
# اِقْتَطَفْتُمْ (iqtaṭaftum) /iq.ta.tˤaf.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
# اُقْتُطِفْتُمْ (uqtuṭiftum) /uq.tu.tˤif.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
